svg.title: Recetario platform at a glance
svg.text: Recetario — the platform at a glance
Prices from five retailers land in a lake, the tables that earn it are promoted to a tested warehouse, and metrics feed data products.
OpenMetadata — one catalog for every layer
discovery · glossary & metrics catalog · column-level lineage · data quality · built-in MCP for AI
Dagster — orchestrates every step as one asset graph
schedules · sensors · lineage lake → marts · dbt tests as asset checks · run history · failure alerts
Docker Compose — one image for dlt + dbt + Dagster
GitHub Actions CI on every push
